{
  "dataset_name": "led24",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "segment_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of all 7 LED segment bits, representing total number of active segments. Different digits have distinct segment counts, providing a coarse digit discriminator.",
      "value_range": [0, 7],
      "feature_family": "segment_aggregation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear separability boost: digits like 1 (2 segments) vs 8 (7 segments) are directly separable on this axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "attribute#1.astype(float) + attribute#2.astype(float) + attribute#3.astype(float) + attribute#4.astype(float) + attribute#5.astype(float) + attribute#6.astype(float) + attribute#7.astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "segment_sum_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Segment sum normalized to [0,1] by dividing by 7 (maximum possible segments). Provides a smooth continuous score suitable for SVM margins.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_aggregation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized continuous feature improves SVM margin geometry by placing all observations on a common scale.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#1.astype(float) + attribute#2.astype(float) + attribute#3.astype(float) + attribute#4.astype(float) + attribute#5.astype(float) + attribute#6.astype(float) + attribute#7.astype(float)) / 7.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "top_segments_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of top horizontal and upper vertical segments (attributes 1,2,3,4): captures upper display region activation pattern.",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "segment_region",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Upper region pattern helps distinguish digits with similar total counts but different spatial distributions (e.g., 7 vs 4).",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "attribute#1.astype(float) + attribute#2.astype(float) + attribute#3.astype(float) + attribute#4.astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bottom_segments_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of lower display segments (attributes 5,6,7): captures lower display region activation pattern.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "segment_region",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Lower region pattern complements upper region for spatial digit discrimination in linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "attribute#5.astype(float) + attribute#6.astype(float) + attribute#7.astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "top_bottom_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of top segment sum to total segment sum, clipped to avoid division by zero. Measures relative upper vs lower display density.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ratio feature captures spatial balance of digit display, useful for separating digits with similar counts but different distributions.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#1.astype(float) + attribute#2.astype(float) + attribute#3.astype(float) + attribute#4.astype(float)) / np.maximum(attribute#1.astype(float) + attribute#2.astype(float) + attribute#3.astype(float) + attribute#4.astype(float) + attribute#5.astype(float) + attribute#6.astype(float) + attribute#7.astype(float), 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "middle_segment_weighted",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Attribute 4 (middle horizontal segment) weighted by total segment count. Middle segment presence is highly discriminative for certain digits.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_weighted",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Middle segment is absent in digits 0,1,7 and present in 2,3,4,5,6,8,9 - weighted version provides smooth discriminative signal.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "attribute#4.astype(float) * (attribute#1.astype(float) + attribute#2.astype(float) + attribute#3.astype(float) + attribute#4.astype(float) + attribute#5.astype(float) + attribute#6.astype(float) + attribute#7.astype(float)) / 7.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "segment_deviation_from_mean",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of segment sum from the training mean segment count (approximately 4.5 for balanced digit distribution). Measures how extreme the segment count is.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.5],
      "feature_family": "segment_deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Deviation from mean helps SVM identify extreme digit patterns (very few or very many segments) as distinct from average-count digits.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs((attribute#1.astype(float) + attribute#2.astype(float) + attribute#3.astype(float) + attribute#4.astype(float) + attribute#5.astype(float) + attribute#6.astype(float) + attribute#7.astype(float)) - 4.5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vertical_segments_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of vertical segment attributes (2,3,5,6): captures vertical stroke density which varies systematically across digits.",
      "value_range": [0, 4],
      "feature_family": "segment_region",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Vertical segment count distinguishes digits like 1 (2 verticals) from 8 (4 verticals), providing an orthogonal discriminative axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "attribute#2.astype(float) + attribute#3.astype(float) + attribute#5.astype(float) + attribute#6.astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "horizontal_segments_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of horizontal segment attributes (1,4,7): captures horizontal stroke density which varies across digits.",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "segment_region",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Horizontal segment count provides complementary axis to vertical count for digit discrimination in linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "attribute#1.astype(float) + attribute#4.astype(float) + attribute#7.astype(float)"
    },
    {
      "name": "vertical_horizontal_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between normalized vertical and horizontal segment sums, measuring display orientation bias. Ranges from -1 (all horizontal) to +1 (all vertical).",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Balance score provides a signed continuous feature that SVM can use as a linear projection axis for orientation-based digit separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#2.astype(float) + attribute#3.astype(float) + attribute#5.astype(float) + attribute#6.astype(float)) / 4.0 - (attribute#1.astype(float) + attribute#4.astype(float) + attribute#7.astype(float)) / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "segment_pattern_complexity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction score combining segment sum with middle segment presence: sum * (1 + middle_segment). Amplifies complexity for digits with middle segment active.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 14.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Multiplicative interaction captures non-linear digit patterns in a single continuous feature, approximating polynomial kernel effects for linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(attribute#1.astype(float) + attribute#2.astype(float) + attribute#3.astype(float) + attribute#4.astype(float) + attribute#5.astype(float) + attribute#6.astype(float) + attribute#7.astype(float)) * (1.0 + attribute#4.astype(float))"
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_digit_ambiguity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how ambiguous the segment pattern is for digit identification. Score from 0 (highly distinctive pattern) to 1 (highly ambiguous, many possible digit matches). Based on how many digits share similar segment counts and spatial patterns. Patterns with 2 segments score near 0 (only digit 1), patterns with 5-6 segments score near 1 (many possible digits: 2,3,5,6,9,0).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ambiguity score helps SVM weight uncertain observations differently, improving margin calibration for hard-to-classify digit patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
